topic: Five ways brands make it worse

slides.headline: Five ways brands make a bad Trustpilot review worse
Arguing in the reply.
slides.body: Every future buyer reads it, and they rarely side with the business.

slides.headline: Offering something to change it.
slides.body: Incentives to edit or remove a review break Trustpilot's rules.

slides.headline: Buying 5-stars to bury it.
slides.body: Trustpilot can put a public warning on your page. That's far worse than one bad review.

slides.headline: Posting the customer's details.
slides.body: “Order #4471 was delivered on time” is a privacy problem, not a defense.

slides.headline: Leaving it for months.
slides.body: It sits there doing damage, and recent reviews count the most.

slides.headline: Send us the link. We'll tell you if it may have a case.
slides.sub: You only pay once it's gone.
